ModMetaData.name: Radius UI - Mission Control Fixes
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description: Restores Mission Control letter envelope clicks to the original Letter.OpenLetter behavior, including choice and growth dialogs. Fixes missing vanilla letter buttons when the panel and styled-letter settings differ. Persists the floating minimap position after dragging and when locked. Restores full-text hover panes for letters, messages and alerts, with wrapped titles and wheel scrolling for text taller than the screen. Standalone Harmony patch for RimWorld 1.6; load after Radius UI Framework and Radius UI - Mission Control. Uses the original minimap settings; does not modify or redistribute the original mods.
